iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

FTP::enable
       Enable FTP protocol handler.

SYNOPSIS
       FTP::enable

DESCRIPTION
       Enable FTP protocol handler for FTP message processing. This will enable detection of "AUTH TLS/SSL" for FTP.

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       SERVER_CONNECTED CLIENT_ACCEPTED

EXAMPLES
	when CLIENT_ACCEPTED {
	    if { !([IP::addr [IP::client_addr] equals 10.0.0.0/8]) } {
		FTP::enable
	    }
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-14.0.0 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
